cases.title: Verify presence of Classic and Modern themes under themes preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open and themes preferences panel is accessible. Steps: Navigate to the themes preferences. Expected: Both Classic and Modern themes exist under the themes preferences.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open and main window is displayed. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: Theme Preferences item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open and main window is displayed. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: Get New Themes item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open and main window is displayed. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: Classic item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open and main window is displayed. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: Modern item is available under the View menu.

opinions.feedback: Evidence is insufficient to confirm any blockers as the supplied cases cover the testable requirements and no concrete contradictions or untestable scenarios are present in the cases G-001 through G-005.

Cases G-001 through G-005 are properly grounded in their respective requirements. However, requirements R-176 and R-177 lack test cases, and no test cases verify the display of themes against images. Blocker assessment is incomplete due to missing coverage.
confirmed_blockers: Requirements R-176 and R-177 are missing test cases to verify that Classic and Modern themes are displayed as in the given images.

analysis.analysis: Based on the validator feedback, requirements R-176 and R-177 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display unverifiable. Consequently, scenarios associated with R-176 and R-177 cannot be effectively tested against a concrete visual specification without the missing assets.
